validation.command: bash scripts/cloud_research.sh /workspace/coin/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_native_action_availability.py tests/test_native_action_inputs.py tests/test_native_action_teacher.py

behavior: Only explicitly available one-hot actions are simulated and selected.
Unavailable reward slots are null/NaN with an explicit e6_available mask, never zero.
Ridge losses, utility-gap weights and label-state metrics use available candidates only.
Source checkpoint SHA is checked against causal schedule intervals and label/publication clocks.
Date range and maturity cutoff are explicit. An unsupported newly available head fails closed.
Original all-six default fit arrays match exactly; financial account, costs, ramp and caps are unchanged.

input_contract.action_eligible_shape: [days,6] or [days,8], first six are E6 in the frozen order
input_contract.source_checkpoint_shape: [days] Unicode SHA256; empty string means no checkpoint
input_contract.clocks: Integer UTC microseconds; start inclusive and end exclusive
input_contract.unavailable_panel_features: Zero neutral encoding plus availability feature; never a forecast or reward
input_contract.residual_budget: Unavailable expert with nonzero budget requires an explicit exit adapter; stops rather than inventing targets

training_entry: python -m modules.native_action.availability --labels LABELS.jsonl --output MODEL.npz --start-us START --end-us END --asof-us ASOF --checkpoint-schedule SCHEDULE.json
student_entry: python -m modules.native_action.runner student --availability-aware --model MODEL.npz --adapter MODULE:FACTORY --options OPTIONS.json --output NEW_DIRECTORY
production_adapter: LATEST_REAL_ADAPTER_NOT_PRESENT_IN_THIS_EXECUTOR; integration uses the explicit contract above
